entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please state your name and the reason for your call.
Yeah, hi, it's Mark Johnson. I want to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's not working properly.
Thank you for calling, Mr. Johnson. I understand you'd like to return a VeloBand Pulse. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
Ugh, alright, it's mark.johnson@email.com. This is ridiculous, I shouldn't have to jump through hoops just to return something that's faulty.

Thank you, Mr. Johnson. I've located your order. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse 15 days ago on October 26th. Our standard return window for electronics is 10 days. Let me review our return policy for you.
Fifteen days? So what! It's practically new! It's broken! I want a refund. I need this money back.

I understand your frustration, Mr. Johnson. Let me double-check our policy. Unfortunately, our return policy does state a 10-day return window for electronics. Given that it’s past that window, a full refund isn’t possible.
That's insane! What am I supposed to do with a broken VeloBand Pulse? Just throw it away? This is terrible customer service.

Mr. Johnson, I understand your frustration. While a full refund isn't possible due to being outside the return window, I'd like to explore other options. While I can't authorize a refund, I can offer you store credit for the current value of the VeloBand Pulse. Would that be acceptable?

Store credit? What good is that? I need the money, not more stuff from VeloFit. But I guess… what choice do I have? I’m stuck with it, aren’t I? Are you absolutely sure there can't be any policy exception here?

I understand, Mr. Johnson. I've reviewed your account, and unfortunately, a policy exception isn't possible in this instance. However, the store credit will allow you to purchase another item from VeloFit that better suits your needs. We have a wide range of products that may interest you.
Fine. Store credit it is. How does that even work?

Great. I've issued the store credit to your account, accessible with your email address, mark.johnson@email.com. It's equivalent to the current selling price of the VeloBand Pulse. It will automatically apply at checkout on your next purchase. You can use it for any item on our website or in our store.
Okay, I see it. I suppose that's… something. Thank you for at least trying to help. I appreciate it. I'm sorry for being so rude before.
You're very welcome, Mr. Johnson. I'm glad we could find a solution that works for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks again.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
